behaviors.description: A record the create operation stores reads back, whole, under the identifier create returned.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: The read of the identifier create printed finds the record, with that identifier and the title create was given.

directions.text: The id field of its standard output from the create command (with the supplied stdin title) and the read back command (with the supplied option id): the found field of its standard output, the id field of its standard output, and the title field of its standard output is asserted to satisfy every declared condition together. The declared polarity expects this relation to hold. The stdout of the read-back step and the identifier the create step printed. A read-back that finds nothing, or a record under another identifier or with another title is treated as a defect.

safetyLimits: The records command makes no network call and writes only under store/ in its working directory.
